Definition: middle voice from G2126; to be circumspect, i.e. (by implication) to be apprehensive; religiously, to reverence:--(moved with) fear.
BiblicalUsage: eulabéomai means (moved with) fear. In Hebrews 11:7, the text says "moved with fear."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of eulabéomai I do not force more than it gives: fear.
